report.summary: Patient P-D012 is a 47-year-old Medicaid member (Lakeshore Community Health Plan) with a transportation benefit and no steady housing. Current medications (insulin glargine pen $2/month, gabapentin $1/month) have low copays and no refill gaps, but cost assistance is still available. Social screener indicates a transportation need and food worry sometimes true. Census tract 17031230500 is low-income, 32.6% of households have no vehicle, and there are 47 nearby transit stops with early service. Recent appointments: appt:1 podiatry 2026-09-14 09:00 (no-show), appt:2 primary care 2026-10-22 13:00 (kept). Facility locations were not on file, so transit feasibility could not be checked for either appointment.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Short-term copay help for current patients; ask clinic social work or front desk to apply.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Help applying for Extra Help/Low-Income Subsidy and manufacturer patient-assistance programs.

options.name: Prescription savings card signup
options.how_to_access: Online form to check qualification; responds within one business day. Needs name, DOB, medications, insurance.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: Eligible as Medicaid plan member with transport benefit; call the number on the insurance card at least 2 business days before the appointment to schedule non-emergency medical transportation.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions can take up to 21 days, so apply well ahead of needed rides.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free weekday rides to medical appointments, but patient is 47 and not age-eligible (60+). Listed only as not appropriate.
